taken_by: campaign executor, from the independent reviewer's empirical verification
db_posture: read-only (transaction_read_only=on, amjis, PGPORT=5433); no write issued

honest_tension_declared.statement: As with A2, A1's PRODUCTION figure has not moved and must not be made to appear to have.
honest_tension_declared.why: Migration 1094 is deliberately unapplied, and no build has been run through the corrected engine. Every asset_throughput row still reads NULL. Running a production build purely to make an after-figure look good would also violate the campaign's own prohibition on rebuilding the estate to test.
honest_tension_declared.resolution: The after-metric is measured on CAPABILITY - whether the engine can now measure what it claims to measure, and for which writers - not on rows. The production figure is reported unchanged and labelled unchanged.

before.shape: writer-dependent lottery - the engine summed only what each writer chose to self-report in WriterResult.duration_seconds, which defaults to 0.0
before.implication: roughly 201 of 268 rows would have stayed NULL, including every L2 and L4 asset

after.shape: writer-independent - the orchestrator brackets its own invocation with time.monotonic()
after.mechanism: WriterBase.plan_substeps defaults to exactly one SubStep and run_substep defaults to self.run(ctx), so a light writer's run() executes INSIDE the bracket - timing both shapes is the same call site
after.dispatch_coverage: reviewer traced run_asset: data assets, service-assets-with-writers, and the probe-fail regenerate path all funnel through _run_data_writer -> _drive_substeps; nothing else invokes writer code

primary_after_figure.direction: predicted direction, confirmed - the reviewer's wording is that the per-layer lottery is gone AS A CONCEPT, not merely improved
primary_after_figure.instrument: reviewer constructed a genuine light writer (run() only, no self-reported duration, real sleep(0.25)) and drove it through the real _drive_substeps
primary_after_figure.empirical_result: rows=500, engine-measured duration=0.2528s, persisted duration_seconds=0.2528, rows_per_second=1977.5

production_figure_unchanged_and_labelled.metric: asset_throughput rows with a non-null rows_per_second
production_figure_unchanged_and_labelled.why_unchanged: migration 1094 is intentionally unapplied and no build has been run through the corrected engine. This figure moves on the first real build after the migration lands, and not before.
production_figure_unchanged_and_labelled.query: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rows_per_second IS NOT NULL) AS with_rate, count(*) AS total FROM asset_throughput;

residual_null_paths_after_the_fix.note: Enumerated because two drafts of DECISIONS_FOR_THE_NATIVE.md asserted a coverage absolute without checking these. NULL remains a normal, frequent and CORRECT reading.

paths.reason: legacy health-probe service assets, no registered writer
writer never runs, nothing to time
migration 1094 not applied in that environment
paths.frequency: environment-wide when it bites; now observable via logger.warning + asset.duration_columns_absent event

paths.reason: every substep already complete via completed_keys, duration sums to 0.0
8 writer call sites pass no duration; blocked by stop condition 8(2)
paths.frequency: 8 call sites - the subject of decision D-1

n8_detector.claim: a failed build records NO rate, not a zero
n8_detector.code_path_that_makes_it_read_null: _compute_duration_and_rate is called only from the success-completion write site. mark_asset_error, the orphan-crash reap, the service-probe GREEN branch and _skip_no_delta never call it and never name the columns, so they read NULL by omission.
n8_detector.guard: None / 0 / negative / non-finite duration -> (None, None). A genuine positive duration with 0 rows -> (duration, 0.0), an honest measured zero deliberately distinguished from an unknown.
n8_detector.subsystem_health_detector_added: on the absent branch the probe emits logger.warning naming the column and migration, plus emit_event asset.duration_columns_absent, once per process - so a fleet-wide measurement outage is distinguishable from ordinary per-row NULLs

fabricated_rate_hazard_closed.statement: duration and rate are pinned BEFORE the no-op-completion reclassification block can overwrite rows_written with a presence-probe count from prior runs
fabricated_rate_hazard_closed.why_it_matters: pairing an inherited row count with this run's near-zero duration would have produced a confident, entirely fabricated throughput number - the SATYA-DIPA N.8 defect class
fabricated_rate_hazard_closed.verification: reviewer read every line between pin (1117/1181) and write (1249/1308) across both correction passes and confirmed the only mutation of rows_written is the reclassification block
